newsitem.title: UK: Debonair spreads its wings in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Debonair spreads its wings in Europe.

text.p: Start-up British carrier Debonair International Airways Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday that it will launch a daily service to Rome from its Luton hub from November 21.
At the same time, Debonair will also start once-daily, non-stop services from Munich and Barcelona to Rome and a daily one stop service from Copenhagen to Rome, the company said in a statement.

Debonair has been expanding its European network since July with the start of non-stop flights between Barcelona and Munich and inter-Germany flights between Duesseldorf Express Airport and Munich. On October 1, the airline will launch direct flights from Luton to Copenhagen.
With the addition of Rome, Debonair will provide daily services between London, Newcastle, Barcelona, Madrid, Munich, Duesseldorf Express Airport, Copenhagen and Rome.
